ASAS-SN describes Sky Patrol light curves as public and provides publication citations. CTAS may link an operator to the official HTTPS coordinate-query page. runs.claimBoundary: A ranking of retained catalogued galaxies under stated priors; the most probable candidate is a suggestion for follow-up, not a host identification, and a host fainter than the catalogues or outside their cones is always possible.

rules.missed: a host not in the retained catalogues counts as one candidate at f = missedFractionalOffset
rules.offset: f = separation / directional light radius (SIMBAD shape), else separation x kpc/arcsec(z) / physical scale, else separation / angular scale; term exp(-f); f > maxFractionalOffset gives 0
rules.probable: the top candidate is 'probable' when its posterior >= probablePosterior and >= probableRatio x the next hypothesis
rules.redshift: only when the transient and the candidate both have a redshift: exp(-0.5 (dz / sigma)^2), sigma^2 = sum of the stated errors^2 + floor^2

warnings: some candidates have neither a retained shape nor a redshift; their offsets use the stated angular scale
the transient has no retained redshift; the redshift term was not used

runs.claimBoundary: An empirical shared-shape Bazin description of the retained difference photometry and an observer-frame single-temperature colour screen. No extinction, K-correction, redshift or explosion model is fitted; the temperature is not a physical photospheric temperature claim.

parameters.light_curve_model: shared t0, rise and fall; independent positive amplitude and baseline by band
parameters.sed_model: single-temperature Planck shape fitted to near-simultaneous AB flux densities

gate_failures: requires at least three near-simultaneous recognized AB bands

warnings: The shared-shape Bazin model is empirical and does not identify an explosion model.
AB zeropoints, Galactic/host extinction, K-corrections, and filter transmission curves are not fitted.

Reported parameter uncertainties are local covariance estimates conditional on the empirical model and supplied independent Gaussian flux errors; they exclude model, calibration, extinction, redshift, and passband systematics.
Peak magnitudes, peak colors, and model peak time are point estimates; propagated uncertainties for those derived quantities are withheld.
A temperature screen was withheld because its independent gates failed.
